text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#4621 — KMS decrypt error rate spike in us-west-2 (severity: P1) :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Incident PD#4621 created and paged escalation policy 'oncall-sre'.
maria: acked PD#4621 — taking it. seeing lots of 500s from the inference-facing decrypt path.
jason: on it, can you dump a few example errors?
maria: past 5m snapshot: 500s with message 'KMS.Decrypt failed: KeyNotFoundException' and a bunch of throttling 429s. sample log:
```
2026-03-09T18:15:12Z ERROR svc.inference.decrypt request_id=xx-yy-zz error=KMS.Decrypt failed key_id=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01 code=NotFound
2026-03-09T18:15:13Z WARN  svc.inference.decrypt request_id=aa-bb-cc retries=2 error=KMS.ThrottlingException
```
sophia: is this happening only for rotation keys? I see a recent rotation job kicked at 18:00 UTC.
maria: correlation looks strong — errors spike right after rotation job finished. traffic that hits cache-miss paths (new sessions) are failing to decrypt customer tokens. impact: about 4-6% of hosted API calls 500ing for last 12m. sending telemetry summary to incident ticket.
kevin: can we short-circuit to the previous key version? runbook step 3 suggests fallback to previous key alias if rotation failed.
jason: quick check: `aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2` returns both keys but the new key state is 'PendingDeletion'? that would explain NotFound perf. running exact query now.
maria: +1 on fallback. can someone check rotation job logs (rotation-service) to see if it marked old key deprecated.
ops-bot: rotation-service: run 2026-03-09T18:00:03Z finished with status=success code=0 job_id=rot-20260309-12
ops-bot: alarm: rotation-service logged warnings about slow HSM sign-with: 12 retries during key material import.
sophia: if the HSM import partially succeeded we might have alias pointing to a key ARN that isn't fully ready. that leads to NotFound at Decrypt time.
kevin: short mitigation plan: 1) turn off new key alias for production (repoint alias to previous key) 2) increase local retry/backoff in decrypt path + 3 second jitter 3) enable synchronous fallback to cached secrets for active sessions. who can do alias change?
jason: I can run alias update but need IAM perms. @maria can you confirm and authorize?
maria: authorized. jason, go ahead. while you do that i'll raise an advisory to customers.
jason: running:
```
aws kms update-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-prod --target-key-id 1234abcd-previous
```
jason: command succeeded. alias now points to previous key.
maria: monitoring. initial error rate drops in next 40s. good.
pagerduty: PD#4621 acknowledged by maria at 18:21:02 UTC. escalation stopped.
kevin: reverting alias fixes decrypt for in-flight cold-starts but we should still backfill tokens that hit the new key ARNs. running a small migration job to re-encrypt affected blobs with previous key.
sophia: also recommend we throttle rotation-service concurrency and add an HSM health check to the runbook. create ticket?
maria: created ticket RK-789: 'rotation-service: add HSM import validation + concurrency limit' — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RK-789
ops-bot: temporary mitigation: deployed decrypt retry bump (retries: 2->5, base backoff 100ms->600ms) to staging then prod.
maria: customer impact note: hosted API customers saw 4-6% 500s between 18:15-18:23 UTC, primarily in us-west-2. No data exfiltration. we've reopened short support queue and notified top 10 customers.
jason: handing off to kevin for post-incident cleanup and root cause. maria -> kevin oncall handoff in 10m.
kevin: taking over. summary for next oncall: rotation job likely imported key material incompletely (HSM latency) causing alias to point to a key that returned NotFound until a transient HSM state resolved. mitigation: alias rollback, increased retries, queued re-encrypt job. followups: add HSM readiness probe, add alias sanity check in rotation pipeline, increase alarm thresholds for rotation-service failures.
sophia: I'll own the rotation-service fixes. adding acceptance tests to ensure alias resolves to usable key ARN before switching.
maria: thanks team. leaving the channel — all ops stable, will be reachable if anything flares.
kevin: thanks, reassigning PD#4621 to postmortem. closing pagerduty notification.
pagerduty: PD#4621 status changed to 'resolved' by kevin at 18:34:58 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident note appended: 'Alias rollback restored production decrypts. root cause: HSM import latency causing alias to point to not-ready key. Followups: RK-789, RK-790 (postmortem), security review.'
kevin: quick handoff summary pinned: 1) timeframe 18:15-18:23 UTC 2) impact 4-6% 500s us-west-2 3) immediate mitigations done 4) followups created RK-789, RK-790
ops-bot: scheduled postmortem meeting: 2026-03-10T15:00:00Z calendar invite sent to oncall, infra, ml-infra.
maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
